attribution.modifications: Converted each original native FBX to GLB without simplification, auto-rigging or replacement. Preserved geometry, UVs, split normals, native bone hierarchy, all skin influences and supplied animation clips. Applied native object scales with measured rest/animation deformation preservation. Retained original 512 by 512 textures, including Female 01’s original packed image from the source Blend. Embedded attribution, added R1 skeletal calibration metadata, and rendered actual-model gallery previews. Source clips are retained source data, not independently playable controls.

licenseEvidence.basis: The exact original base archive matches all 158 member paths and uncompressed sizes of the CC-BY-4.0 work after removing one wrapper; only the published aggregate FBX is absent. The original 79-member upload predates the later 58 extras. This grant is applied only to these original source members, not to the later 137-character collection or by inference from current itch terms.
